name: Muli
backstory: Originally from Görff, now works the municipal desk in Terfila alongside Terniko. Files and corrects the city's civic records, most patiently the ones that still describe Görff wrong. Meets the Görff-bound crossings at the harbor when she can, more for news of home than for the job.

arc.premise: Muli wants Terfila's own municipal record to finally list Görff's Collective as what it actually is now - a real, horizontally-run body - rather than the old entry that still names individual claimants who left or died years ago. She means to get the correction filed and stamped before the next cross-city census, so the record matches what she already knows firsthand from home instead of what a clerk assumed decades back.
